components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When provided it must be unique across owners.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's display name, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's initials, the first letter of the first and last name, upper-cased and dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            registrationDate:
              title: Registration date
              description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to today when not supplied at creation.
              type: string
              format: date
              example: '2024-01-15'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's sequential membership number, assigned at creation as one more than the number of owners that existed before.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 11
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, assigned at creation as '<UPPERCASE_CITY>-<NNNN>' where NNNN is one more than the number of owners already in that city, zero-padded to four digits.
              type: string
              example: LONDON-0007
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

Implemented digits-only telephone storage with normalization applied before the uniqueness check.

**Changes:**

1. **`rest/function/owner/Telephones.java`** (new) — small helper `digitsOnly(String)` that strips everything except digits (handles spaces, dashes, parentheses), returning `null` unchanged.

2. **`rest/function/owner/BuildOwner.java`** (POST `/api/owners`) — normalizes the telephone to digits right after mapping the request into the `Owner`, so the subsequent `checkDuplicate` step (`CheckDuplicateOwner`) compares normalized values. This makes `(613) 555-0100` and `6135550100` collide → 409.

3. **`rest/function/owner/ApplyOwner.java`** (PUT `/api/owners/{ownerId}`) — normalizes on update too, keeping the stored value digits-only.

4. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — relaxed the `OwnerFields.telephone` bind pattern from `^[0-9]*$` to `^[-0-9 ()]*$` so a punctuated number is accepted at the request edge (previously it was rejected with a 400 before any normalization could run). The `Owner` entity's `@Pattern(^[0-9]{10}$)` still enforces exactly 10 digits on the *stored* (normalized) value.

The stored digits are returned as-is in the response `telephone` field (`GET` reads back `6135550100`). Since normalization happens in `BuildOwner` before `CheckDuplicateOwner`, and the entity setter is untouched, the domain model stays unchanged per project conventions.

The `Cp11Tests` (both `coreStoresDigitsOnly` and `functionalityNormalisedDuplicateRejected`) now pass, along with the full suite (271 tests, 0 failures).
